definitions.gloss: various places; each place; different regions
definitions.explanation: Multiple places across a country, region, or area. Often used in news reports and formal contexts.

examples.japanese: {全国|ぜんこく}{各地|かくち}で{桜|さくら}が{咲|さ}き{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: Cherry blossoms have started blooming in various places across the country.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}{各地|かくち}に{伝統的|でんとうてき}な{祭|まつ}りがある。
examples.english: There are traditional festivals in various parts of Japan.

examples.japanese: {世界|せかい}{各地|かくち}から{観光客|かんこうきゃく}が{訪|おとず}れる。
examples.english: Tourists visit from all over the world.

notes:
PATTERNS:
・{全国|ぜんこく}{各地|かくち} (various places across the country)
・{日本|にほん}{各地|かくち} (various parts of Japan)
・{世界|せかい}{各地|かくち} (various parts of the world)
・{各地|かくち}で (in various places)
・{各地|かくち}の (of various places)

REGISTER: Formal. Commonly used in news reports, announcements, and written Japanese.

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
・{方々|ほうぼう} (here and there, everywhere - less formal)
・あちこち (here and there - casual)
・{各所|かくしょ} (various locations - similar formality)
・{各国|かっこく} (various countries)

RELATED COMPOUNDS:
・{産地|さんち} (producing area)
・{現地|げんち} (local area, on-site)
